tooltip.luomu.luomu_doll: A little companion in your palm.
tooltip.luomu.controls: Place on blocks. Click display to spin; sneak-click to retrieve. Fits helmet slot. Sneak-use in air to deploy. Click companion to pat; sneak-click to reclaim.
message.luomu.full: Make room in your inventory first.
message.luomu.owner: This doll belongs to another player.
